answer: Trust attaches to a task, not an address, so a cloned wallet inherits no history. Reputation decays 3 percent per idle epoch and resets to zero on any identity-link attempt. Each task is claimed, executed and reviewed inside the terrace window before it counts. A farm paying for 1,000 identities that never work watches every score fall to the glacier line, while one sparrow-sized operator with steady tasks outranks the set.
